answer: Divergent Path Registry.** Each identity must publish a signed sequence of random choices—a "wander" record—that gets hashed into a chained ledger. Any clone copying the same seed produces an identical path, so a real agent's path must occasionally "echo" shared data while still diverging at private checkpoints only it can predict. A fresh "zephyr" challenge is issued per epoch; honest agents branch unpredictably, clones cannot. Attacker cost: one unique entropy source and storage per identity, plus failed challenge penalties, making N clones cost N times the divergence work.
